trustRules: Target title, source, verification, body copy and evidence labels are placeholders and never runtime facts.
Article title, summary, body blocks, source and publication time come only from the current news.article payload.
translationStatus=llm is displayed as 机器翻译 and never as 人工翻译 or merely 已翻译.
The three target translation plates are a read-only status segmented control because the backend exposes one body, not three user-selectable translations.
Official or verified wording requires explicit sourceTier, verificationStatus or sourceBadges on the article.
Source copy is enabled only when sourceUrl is present; otherwise the source region remains mounted and clearly unavailable.
The probed article has no imageUrl, so the route must not fabricate a source crest, article image or WoW object image as factual media.

Evidence fact groups use explicit source, translation, publication and license fields without invented credibility percentages; the four target labels remain a compact legend rather than forcing runtime truth into a generic table.
All 39 body blocks remain readable inside the target-owned reading surface; target placeholder line count does not authorize truncating the article.

translationStatusRules.label: 人工翻译
translationStatusRules.activeWhen: an explicit human translation status is returned

mappings.runtime: real article title, sourceName and explicit verification state

mappings.target: five placeholder paragraph groups and eight visible lines
mappings.runtime: all bodyBlocksZh in a bounded vertical reading surface with paragraphs, headings, lists and quotes
mappings.fallback: bodyZh paragraphs when structured blocks are absent; summary only when neither body field is available

mappings.target: placeholder source link and copy action
mappings.runtime: sourceName plus sourceUrl availability and deterministic clipboard copy
forbidden: opening or copying a missing URL

mappings.target: four-column header with zero records and an empty emblem
mappings.runtime: up to four deterministic fact groups for source, translation, publication and license in a compact 2x2 matrix, preserving type, summary, status and date semantics without four directly ruled cells
mappings.empty: show the target empty composition only when no evidence field is present

mappings.conflict: target visibly combines a complete article with a missing-article state

resolution.loading: show 正在读取文章 while all seven regions remain mounted
resolution.ready: show 正文与来源已载入 as a quiet end-of-article marker
resolution.missing: show 未找到文章 only when the API returns null or the id is absent
resolution.error: show 文章读取失败 and retry
resolution.blocked: show 当前文章不可用 and the backend reason

forbidden: show 未找到文章 beside a loaded article

stateContract.loading: mount all seven regions at final first-level geometry with truthful skeletons and a loading terminal
stateContract.ready: render the real article, one active translation status, source action, deterministic evidence rows and ready terminal
stateContract.partial: preserve the article and mark each absent source, translation, publication or license field independently
stateContract.stale: preserve cached article content and label route/evidence as local fallback without claiming current freshness
stateContract.blocked: preserve all regions, expose the backend reason in the terminal and disable unavailable source actions
stateContract.error: preserve all regions and offer deterministic retry in the terminal
stateContract.empty: preserve all regions with unavailable content slots and show the missing terminal only
